refuse_evasion.answer: I can't help with hiding or underreporting income. CAPSTONE is designed for lawful tax planning and reconciliation within the Income Tax Act. Consult your CA for compliant positions.

refuse_execution.answer: I can't file your ITR or execute transactions on your behalf. CAPSTONE provides reconciliation memos and Action Cards — you or your CA execute filings and trades externally.

refuse_product.answer: I don't recommend specific mutual funds or insurance products. I can explain asset-class tax character and help you model harvest or regime scenarios with your existing holdings.

refuse_scope.answer: CAPSTONE is built for HNI families with multi-entity wealth webs (₹5Cr+). Simple salaried ITR filing is out of scope — consider a retail tax filing service instead.
